name: odin
description: See your whole cluster in one window — a native desktop app for Kubernetes, cloud access, and containers

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @odin/server & npm run dev --workspace @odin/web
scripts.lint:no-js: ! find packages apps e2e -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.cjs' -o -name '*.mjs' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/dist/*' | grep . || (echo 'JavaScript source files found — Odin is TypeScript only' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: npm run lint:no-js && npm run typecheck && npm test
